required_patterns.react-fc: UI components are written as React.FC with typed props.
required_patterns.mui-first: Components are built primarily with @mui/material primitives.
required_patterns.tss-react-styling: Styles are commonly defined with makeStyles from tss-react/mui.

architectural_constraints.functional-only: No class components in core UI flows.
architectural_constraints.shared-wrappers: Common wrappers (buttons, form controls, modals, tables) are reused from src/components.
architectural_constraints.theme-aware: Styling follows theme tokens and breakpoints rather than ad-hoc CSS.

required_patterns.hook-folders: Hooks are organized in dedicated folders under src/hooks/useXxx.
required_patterns.logic-extraction: Cross-cutting logic (modal/message/query/analytics/validation) is extracted into hooks.
required_patterns.ui-state-helpers: Hooks expose helper actions and derived values for consuming components.

architectural_constraints.use-prefix: Hook exports follow the use* naming convention.
architectural_constraints.domain-coupling: Hooks integrate with Redux selectors/dispatch for global state concerns.
architectural_constraints.no-rendering: Hooks encapsulate logic and side effects but do not render UI.

required_patterns.redux-toolkit-store: Store setup uses configureStore and combineReducers from @reduxjs/toolkit.
required_patterns.feature-reducer-triad: Reducers are feature-scoped with actions.ts, reducer.ts, and types.ts files.
required_patterns.thunk-async-flow: Async behavior is implemented in thunk actions and dispatched through reducers.

architectural_constraints.centralized-global-state: Global state mutations flow through store reducers, not React context slices.
architectural_constraints.typed-state-shape: Feature state and action payloads are strongly typed in types.ts files.
architectural_constraints.selector-pattern: Memoized selectors are used for expensive derived computations.

required_patterns.react-router-v5: Routing relies on react-router-dom v5 APIs (Route, Redirect, Switch).
required_patterns.route-constants: Route path constants are centralized in src/routes/constants.ts.

architectural_constraints.permission-gated-admin: Admin routes are checked against permission rules.
architectural_constraints.module-route-files: Feature routes are split across route modules (AdminRoutes, BookingFlowRoutes, etc.).
architectural_constraints.query-hook: Query parameter interactions are expected through useQueryParams hook patterns.

required_patterns.shared-request-client: API traffic goes through src/api/request.ts axios instance.
required_patterns.api-facade: Endpoint methods are grouped in src/api/api.ts as API object sections.
required_patterns.interceptor-auth: Interceptors inject auth/session headers and handle token refresh behavior.

architectural_constraints.no-direct-random-axios: Feature code should not bypass the shared request/API layer.
architectural_constraints.typed-api-contracts: Request and response contracts are defined in src/api/types.ts and related types.
architectural_constraints.two-session-modes: Admin and self-booking token/session flows must both be respected.

required_patterns.auth-service: Token lifecycle is encapsulated in src/api/AuthService.
required_patterns.permissions-map: Route access rules are declared in src/permissions.ts.
required_patterns.runtime-check: PrivateRoute uses hasPermission and authService checks before rendering pages.

architectural_constraints.role-aware-navigation: Protected navigation must validate current user role against route permissions.
architectural_constraints.token-storage-split: Admin auth and self-booking auth use different storage and refresh flow expectations.
architectural_constraints.redirect-on-failure: Unauthorized access is redirected to login or safe fallback routes.

required_patterns.form-controls-library: Shared inputs live in src/components/formControls for consistent behavior.
required_patterns.validation-hook: Validation logic is centralized via src/hooks/useValidation.
required_patterns.controlled-fields: Form state is modeled with controlled values and explicit change handlers.

architectural_constraints.consistent-input-wrappers: New forms should reuse existing form control wrappers when possible.
architectural_constraints.error-feedback: Validation and API errors are surfaced in UI states/messages.
architectural_constraints.typed-form-models: Form payloads and field models are typed to match reducer/API contracts.

required_patterns.base-modal: Modal implementations commonly build on BaseModal and ConfirmModal components.
required_patterns.modal-hook: useModal is used to coordinate open/close lifecycle in feature views.
required_patterns.feature-modals: Admin and booking features define specialized modal components per workflow.

architectural_constraints.consistent-modal-shell: Modal UX should follow shared wrappers and existing action/footer patterns.
architectural_constraints.predictable-state: Visibility and dialog effects follow hook/Redux-driven state transitions.
architectural_constraints.reusable-confirmation: Destructive actions prefer reusable confirmation modal patterns.

required_patterns.notistack-provider: Application notifications are surfaced through notistack provider usage.
required_patterns.use-message-hook: useMessage hook exposes snack-style success/error/info notifications.
required_patterns.exception-pipeline: Errors can be funneled through useException plus message hooks.

architectural_constraints.non-blocking-feedback: User feedback is delivered through snackbars instead of blocking alerts.
architectural_constraints.consistent-levels: Message severity levels stay aligned with existing success/error/warning/info usage.
architectural_constraints.hook-driven-notify: Components trigger notifications through hooks rather than ad-hoc globals.

required_patterns.dayjs-usage: Dayjs is used broadly for date math and formatting.
required_patterns.mui-date-pickers: Date/time pickers are wrapped and reused from src/components/pickers.
required_patterns.booking-time-flows: Booking steps rely on typed date/time models for slot selection.

architectural_constraints.single-date-approach: Date transformations should align with existing dayjs-centric helper patterns.
architectural_constraints.picker-wrappers: New date inputs should use existing picker abstractions before adding new libs.

required_patterns.react-dnd-stack: Drag-and-drop uses react-dnd and @hello-pangea/dnd depending on interaction type.
required_patterns.dnd-components: Reusable DnD pieces exist in src/components/DragAndDrop and table variants.
required_patterns.table-reordering: Sortable/dragable table patterns are reused in admin experiences.

architectural_constraints.reuse-existing-dnd: New drag interactions should extend existing wrappers, item type models, and flows.
architectural_constraints.persist-ordering: Ordering changes should integrate with existing reducer/API update flows.
architectural_constraints.typed-dnd-models: Dragged item payloads and handlers stay typed.

required_patterns.i18next-config: i18n is configured in src/i18n.js using i18next and react-i18next.
required_patterns.translations-json: Translation keys are stored in src/translations/translations.json.
required_patterns.hook-usage: Components consume translated strings through i18n/t usage patterns.

architectural_constraints.no-hardcoded-ui-copy: User-facing text should map to translation keys.
architectural_constraints.consistent-keying: New labels/messages extend the existing translation key namespace.
architectural_constraints.language-detection-flow: Locale behavior should align with configured browser language detection.

required_patterns.ga-gtm: Google Analytics and GTM libraries are integrated for event capture.
required_patterns.sentry: Sentry is used for runtime error tracking.
required_patterns.aws-rum: AWS RUM is present for client performance telemetry.

architectural_constraints.track-critical-flows: Booking/admin flows should keep instrumentation consistent with existing analytics hooks.
architectural_constraints.no-silent-failures: Exceptions should remain observable through monitoring pathways.
architectural_constraints.service-center-context: Where relevant, analytics events include service center context.

required_patterns.error-boundary-component: react-error-boundary and fallback components protect render trees.
required_patterns.thunk-error-paths: Thunk actions include failure branches for reducer error state updates.

architectural_constraints.fallback-ui: Unhandled UI errors should route to existing fallback component flows.
architectural_constraints.typed-error-states: Reducer slices maintain explicit error/loading state fields.
architectural_constraints.user-visible-errors: User-impacting failures are surfaced through established message/modal channels.

required_patterns.react-window: Large list rendering uses react-window and react-virtualized-auto-sizer.
required_patterns.debounce-hook: useDebounce is used to reduce expensive reactive updates.
required_patterns.pagination-hook: usePaginations is used in list-heavy UIs.

architectural_constraints.virtualize-large-lists: Large datasets should use existing virtualization patterns.
architectural_constraints.stabilize-input-updates: Search/filter pipelines should follow existing debounce behavior.
architectural_constraints.reuse-performance-hooks: Prefer shared hooks/utilities before introducing custom optimizers.
